direction_notes: Ultrasound-stimulated mice showed a higher percentage of c-Fos-positive cells than sham in both M2 and V1 (P < 0.01 each).

timing.protocol_description: Pulsed ultrasound (820 kHz, 82 cycles per pulse, 1 kHz pulse repetition frequency, 500 pulses, a duty cycle of 10%) delivered through two needle transducers fixed on the head, simultaneously to M2 and V1. Mice were perfused after a 30 min recovery period.

source_quotes.n_subjects: Six male C57BL/6 mice aged 8–10 weeks and weighing 22 $\mathrm { g } \pm 1$ g were used (sham: $n = 3 .$ , ultrasoundstimulated: $n = 3 )$ .
